newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline has pedal to floor, gains $2-$3.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline has pedal to floor, gains $2-$3.

text.p: NWE gasoline showed renewed strength on Thursday gaining a further $2-$3 a tonne on the back of buoyant U.S. prices and tight local supplies.
Dealers said recent data showing a draw in U.S. gasoline stocks was fuelling a rally on NYMEX which was supported in Europe on tight supplies in both NWE and the Mediterranean.
Cif eurograde cargoes in NWE, which are almost impossible to find before August 15, were as high as $213 compared with $190 two weeks ago.
Dealers said there was nothing to suggest the rally showed any signs of fundamental weakness other than that more material becomes available from mid August onwards.
But, with the Mediterranean market also looking tight few dealers were prepared to talk of a collapse in gasoline prices in the approach to the mid month.
